cases.purpose: Prove three separate writable filesystems, then verify EXDEV rejection in both directions, diagnostic, absent destinations and unchanged sources.
cases.oracle: GNU coreutils link in the same disposable guest with per-side scratch mounts
cases.comparison: Compare status, stdout, stderr and fixture tree; the setup rejects absent or non-distinct filesystem prerequisites. Each invocation must fail with status 1 and nonempty stderr; before/after source snapshots include device, inode, mode, link count, size, mtime and bytes.
cases.setup_script:
/usr/bin/python3 link_control.py preflight
printf payload >src
printf s >/var/tmp/s
cases.script:
/usr/bin/python3 link_control.py snapshot src /var/tmp/s >before || exit 90
r() {
  local label=$1; shift
  echo "[$label]"; echo "[$label]" >&2
  "$@" 2>link-error
  local rc=$?
  [[ $rc -eq 1 && -s link-error ]] || exit 91
  /usr/bin/cat link-error >&2 || exit 92
  echo "[$label] status=$rc"
}
r to-var-tmp link src /var/tmp/alias
r to-dev-shm link src /dev/shm/alias
r into-case link /var/tmp/s dst
[[ ! -e /var/tmp/alias && ! -L /var/tmp/alias && ! -e /dev/shm/alias && ! -L /dev/shm/alias && ! -e dst && ! -L dst ]] || exit 93
/usr/bin/python3 link_control.py snapshot src /var/tmp/s >after || exit 94
/usr/bin/cmp -s before after || exit 95
/usr/bin/rm -f before after link-error
printf 'destinations absent; sources unchanged\n'
